battle.name: 玻利維亞獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 一八〇九年五月，蘇克雷斯與拉巴斯先後舉義，上秘魯礦區民兵把西班牙防線推出安第斯山。卡面這面一五三〇年的方盾出自無敵兵團：前方方盾護住火繩槍手，後方才是長矛與旗幟。到一八〇九年長矛已退役，但它定下的「盾在前、火槍在後」方陣邏輯貫穿整場獨立戰爭，直到一八二四年阿亞庫喬的齊射。

kit.name: 西班牙方陣盾
kit.history: 一面方盾撐住一整排人。無敵兵團的方陣靠它，也靠後面那排火繩槍。

countries: 交戰方分成兩大陣營，戰場集中在今日玻利維亞境內的高原盆地與銀山山脈，西班牙本土只是遙遠的後方。西班牙陣營是里奧德拉普拉塔總督區的王室軍與總督府：1809 年平定上秘魯起義的是以陸軍中將身份活動的何塞·德拉塞爾納；1810 年後由何塞·曼努埃爾·戈伊內切率「秘魯遠征軍」自布宜諾斯艾利斯北上；1816 至 1821 年總督府由霍阿金·德拉佩蘇埃拉主持，1821 年後德拉塞爾納再度署理總督，最後一任是 1824 年抵達前線的何塞·德·坎特拉克。王室軍以本土調來的線列步兵營為骨幹，附屬王室近衛騎兵、輕裝砲兵隊，以及由利馬、波托西、奧魯羅各地召集的克里奧爾民兵，命令由總督逐級下達到營。反對陣營是自稱「主權人民」的上秘魯起義者：1809 年 5 月 25 日蘇克雷斯成立「楚克薩卡最高委員會」接管民政，1810 年拉巴斯另組「瓜查拉帕艾塔主權人民議會」；1822 年後以安東尼奧·何塞·德·蘇克雷斯統率的玻利維亞共和軍為主，並與西蒙·玻利瓦爾率領的委內瑞拉解放軍會合。共和軍的骨幹是克里奧爾自由派與混血民兵，底層是艾馬拉、克丘亞礦工，另有歐美志願者與外籍傭兵。
countriesEn: The two sides formed two great camps. The fighting concentrated on the high plateaux, basins and silver ranges of what is now Bolivia, while metropolitan Spain stood far away as a distant rear. The Spanish camp was the Royal Army and the viceroyal government of the Río de la Plata: the rising in Upper Peru was crushed in 1809 by José de la Serna, then serving as a lieutenant general of the army; from 1810 José Manuel de Goyeneche led the 'Expedition to Peru' north from Buenos Aires; the viceroyalty was governed from 1816 to 1821 by Joaquín de la Pezuela; De la Serna again acted as viceroy after 1821, and the last viceroy was José de Canterac, who reached the front in 1824. The backbone of the Royal Army was made of line infantry battalions transferred from Spain, with the Royal Guard cavalry, light artillery companies, and Creole militias recruited in Lima, Potosí and Oruro; orders ran from the viceroy down to the battalion. The opposing camp was the Upper Peruvian insurgents who called themselves the 'sovereign people': on 25 May 1809 the Committee Supremo of Chuquisaca was created to take over civil government, and in 1810 La Paz set up the Junta of the Sovereign People of Guachapalata. From 1822 the main force was the Bolivian Republican Army under Antonio José de Sucre, operating together with Simón Bolívar's Liberator Army of Venezuela. The backbone of the republican army was the Creole liberal and mestizo militia, with Aymara and Quechua miners at its base, and with volunteers and foreign mercenaries from Europe and the Americas.
people: 起義端最先走出的是三個名字。佩德羅·多明戈·穆里略是拉巴斯市政廳的書記，1809 年 5 月 16 日率民奪權，十天後即在拉巴斯以南的拉塔卡馬平原被西班牙縱隊擊潰，11 月 1 日與塞巴斯蒂安·拉米雷斯一同在市政廳前的廣場被吊死，後來拉巴斯人在同一座廣場掛起穆里略的畫像，那個街角至今仍叫「穆里略角」。圖帕克·卡塔里本名何塞·胡利安·阿帕薩，是艾馬拉礦工出身的領袖，1809 年 10 月率礦民封死拉巴斯城門、切斷糧道，圍城直到翌年 5 月西班牙遠征軍抵達才解圍；他在 1812 年的一次襲擊中被自己人槍殺。托馬斯·卡塔里則於 1809 年底在鄉間自稱印加王，以「印加法」治理部落，1810 年被自己的支持者殺死。蘇克雷斯一側最關鍵的策劃者是何塞·瑪麗亞·梅爾卡多，他在 1809 年 5 月 25 日楚克薩卡議會的成立與最高權力的宣示中扮演主導角色。共和國軍真正的統帥是安東尼奧·何塞·德·蘇克雷斯，這位生於委內瑞拉庫馬納的年輕軍官 1809 年已是烏曼塔省代表，1822 年在皮欣查擊潰西班牙主力，1824 年再於胡寧與阿亞庫喬取勝，1825 年翻越安第斯山回到上秘魯，隨後當選玻利維亞第一任總統。西蒙·玻利瓦爾在 1824 年率解放軍入秘魯，扮演了把主力引向胡寧與阿亞庫喬的角色，最終止於 1830 年的哥倫比亞。西班牙方面的關鍵人物有何塞·德拉塞爾納、何塞·曼努埃爾·戈伊內切、霍阿金·德拉佩蘇埃拉與末任總督何塞·德·坎特拉克。另有拉巴斯議會首任主席何塞·巴利維安，以及一支在阿亞庫喬以長矛騎兵衝鋒的「死亡骯髏騎兵」隊，隊長姓名各書記載不一。
peopleEn: Three names came out of the insurgent side first. Pedro Domingo Murillo was a clerk of the La Paz town council; on 16 May 1809 he led the people to seize the town, was beaten ten days later by a Spanish column on the Latacama plain south of the city, and on 1 November was hanged together with Sebastián Ramírez in the square before the council house. Potosí later hung a painted image of the two men from the same banner on its walls. Túpac Katari, born José Julián Apaza, was a leader who had been an Aymara miner; from October 1809 he shut the gates of La Paz, cut the supply road and held the city under blockade until a Spanish expedition relieved it in May of the following year, and he was shot by his own men during an attack in 1812. Tomás Katari proclaimed himself an Inca in the countryside at the end of 1809 and governed his communities under 'Inca law'; he was killed by his own supporters in 1810. The chief organiser on the Sucre side was José María Mercado, who dominated the founding of the Chuquisaca assembly on 25 May 1809 and the proclamation of supreme power. The real commander of the republican army was Antonio José de Sucre, the young officer born in Cumaná, Venezuela, who was already the delegate for the province of Cumaná in 1809, destroyed the Spanish main army at Pichincha in 1822, won again at Junín and Ayacucho in 1824, and crossed the Andes back into Upper Peru in 1825 before becoming the first President of Bolivia. Simón Bolívar entered Peru with his Liberator Army in 1824 and played the role of drawing the main force towards Junín and Ayacucho; he died in Colombia in 1830. The decisive Spanish figures were José de la Serna, José Manuel de Goyeneche, Joaquín de la Pezuela and the last viceroy, José de Canterac. Also present were José Ballivián, first president of the La Paz assembly, and the 'Hussars of Death', a lancer squadron that charged at Ayacucho; the name of its commander differs from book to book.
kits: 卡面這面方盾是無敵兵團的裝備，本質上是加大加厚的方形大盾（pavesa），前方一列火繩槍手跪著或半跪在盾後裝藥，盾面正中鑄鐵凸包還能當門板撞開，後方才是長矛手與旗手。同一套裝備裡，長矛手戴的是小圓盾（broquel），頭上戴冑（morion），腰間掛一條滿是「十二使徒」小彈筒的彈帶，一條彈帶打完一次齊射再裝下一次。十七世紀起長矛與火繩槍在西班牙軍中相繼退場，方盾從此只留在軍械庫與儀仗裡；到 1809 年方陣盾兵早已不存在，但它養成的編制——按班、按列編號、分段輪射、翼側進退有序——正是西班牙線列步兵血脈裡的東西。獨立戰爭實際使用的武器已完全是另一套：西班牙步兵用 1802 年式燧發滑膛槍，配套筒刺刀與刺刀架；共和軍則大量使用英國製的滑膛槍（Brown Bess）與舊式火繩槍，刺刀多為斷續式或直刃單刃，另有本地鍛造的短刀、長矛（chuzo）與投石索（honda）。砲兵以四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅野戰砲為主，另有輕裝騎砲。交通全靠騾子、驢與羊駝，糧食有馬鈴薯、穀物與玉米，鹽與火藥則長期短缺。防守工事多依山而建：蘇克雷斯城上有聖伯納多山，拉巴斯有聖佩德羅山，皮欣查一役的堡壘築在山脊與斜坡上。
kitsEn: The square shield on the card belongs to the tercios. In substance it is an enlarged and thickened pavise: a front rank of arquebusiers kneels or half-kneels behind it while loading, the iron boss in its centre could even be used to ram a door open, and only behind that stood the pikemen and the ensigns. Within the same equipment set the pikemen carried a small round shield, the broquel, and wore the morion on the head, with a bandolier of small charges, the 'twelve apostles', hung at the waist so that one bandolier supplied one complete volley. From the seventeenth century pikes and matchlocks had left the Spanish army in turn, and the pavise survived only in armouries and on parade. By 1809 tercio pikemen were long gone, but the organisation the shield had created — numbering files and ranks, firing by sections, moving the wings in order — was precisely what still ran in the blood of the Spanish line infantry. The weapons actually used during the war of independence belonged to a wholly different age: the Spanish foot carried the 1802-pattern flintlock musket with a socket bayonet and bayonet belt; the republican armies used large quantities of British smoothbores, the Brown Bess, together with obsolete matchlocks, their bayonets often single-edged or of the broken-off type, and in addition locally forged short swords, the chuzo pike, and the honda sling. The artillery consisted mainly of four, six, eight and twelve pounder field guns, with light horse guns. Transport depended on mules, donkeys and llamas; the food was potatoes, grain and maize, while salt and gunpowder were chronically short. Works were built into the hills: the Cerro de San Bernardo above Chuquisaca, the Cerro de San Pedro above La Paz, and the redoubts of Pichincha on ridge and slope.
tactics: 1809 年的起義軍善用高原地形：礦工佔領城周山頭，用投石索、石塊與火槍從上往下壓制，試圖用圍城與斷糧拖垮守軍。穆里略最大的失誤是放棄拉巴斯城垣、主動出城到南部平原列陣，在那裡被縱隊行軍加騎兵側擊的西班牙縱隊徹底打散；退守之後，圖帕克·卡塔里把圍城推到極致，封死四門、切斷鹽與火藥，僵持約七個月，靠的是地形與封鎖，不是正面火力。西班牙軍的戰術核心是十六世紀以來未變的原則：縱隊行軍、展成單薄的線、逐段齊射、刺刀衝鋒破線，密集的步兵縱隊配合騎兵繞到翼側與側後。1813 年維爾卡普希奧一役，西班牙縱隊正是靠峽谷地形把蘇克雷斯的行軍縱隊整批吃掉。共和軍在蘇克雷斯手裡改為「以守待戰」：皮欣查一役他先固守欽查馬、查里莫亞斯一帶高地，切斷敵軍水源，把決戰日期一拖再拖，直到 1822 年 7 月 25 日夜襲翼側山梁、清晨奪取制高點，才把守軍壓向後方。1824 年阿亞庫喬，他仍把陣地佈在缺水的高地脊線上，步兵營層層設防，砲兵壓住坡面，等西班牙縱隊在缺水與地形中被拖成一團，最後以近距離密集齊射與「死亡骯髏騎兵」的長矛衝鋒收掉戰局。1825 年翻越安第斯山的一路，物資極度匱乏，靠騡隊與當地嚮導分批運送。
tacticsEn: The insurgents of 1809 exploited the highland terrain well: miners seized the heights around the town and pressed down with slings, stones and muskets, trying to starve the garrison by blockade and by cutting its supplies. Murillo's gravest error was to abandon the walls of La Paz and march out to array in the plain to the south, where he was completely broken up by a Spanish column that marched in column of route and then turned the flank with cavalry; after falling back, Túpac Katari pushed the blockade to its limit, sealing all four gates and cutting salt and gunpowder, and the stalemate lasted some seven months, won by geography and strangulation rather than by firepower. The core of Spanish tactical doctrine was unchanged since the sixteenth century: march in column, deploy into a thin line, fire by sections, charge with the bayonet to break the line, with dense infantry columns working hand in hand with cavalry that worked round the flank and the rear. At Vilcapugio in 1813 it was a column advancing through a gorge that swallowed Sucre's marching column whole. Under Sucre the republican army fought defensively instead: at Pichincha he held the heights of Quinchamaya and Chirimoyas, cut the water supply of the enemy and postponed the decisive battle again and again, until on the night of 25 July 1822 he struck the lateral ridge and seized the heights at daybreak, pushing the defenders backwards. At Ayacucho in 1824 he still chose the dry ridge as his line, the battalions deployed in depth, the guns commanding the slope, and he waited until the Spanish columns were exhausted and dislocated by thirst and by the ground before closing with massed close-range volleys and the lance charge of the Hussars of Death. On the 1825 crossing of the Andes supplies were extremely thin and moved in small mule caravans guided by local guides.
data: 以下數字多來自彼此互有出入的戰史記載，只宜當作量級參考。1809 年 5 月拉巴斯城居民約兩萬上下，蘇克雷斯約一萬二千至一萬五千，波托西與奧魯羅則是銀礦區，礦工人口密集。拉塔卡馬一役，起義軍陣亡數百人（常見記載約三百人），西班牙縱隊傷亡數十人。拉巴斯圍城自 1809 年 10 月延到 1810 年 5 月，約七個月。1813 年 11 月 6 日維爾卡普希奧，蘇克雷斯率約一千九百餘人進入峽谷，全軍覆沒，他本人重傷被俘。1822 年 5 月 18 日皮欣查，共和軍約二千二百人，西班牙軍約五千人，皇家軍死傷約七百、被俘或逃散近千人，共和軍陣亡約二百。1824 年 8 月 6 日胡寧，玻利瓦爾部約二千人，坎特拉克部約三千五百至四千人，皇家軍死傷約一千，共和軍陣亡約二百五十。1824 年 12 月 9 日阿亞庫喬，蘇克雷斯部約二千三百至三千人，西班牙軍連胡寧殘部與增援約一萬三千至一萬六千人，西班牙軍陣亡約二千至二千八百、被俘約二千，共和軍損失約二百至三百人。1825 年 8 月 9 日玻利維亞共和國宣告成立。另有 1822 年一筆以英鎊計的借款，約一百六十八萬鎊，抵押物寫的是上秘魯礦產。
dataEn: The figures below come from battle histories that differ from one another, and should be taken as orders of magnitude rather than exact values. La Paz had perhaps twenty thousand inhabitants in May 1809 and Sucre between twelve and fifteen thousand, while Potosí and Oruro were silver districts densely populated by miners. At Latacama the insurgents lost several hundred men, around three hundred in the accounts most often cited, against a few dozen casualties on the Spanish side. The blockade of La Paz ran from October 1809 to May 1810, some seven months. On 6 November 1813 at Vilcapugio Sucre marched into the gorge with about one thousand nine hundred men and the army was annihilated, himself being wounded and captured. On 18 May 1822 at Pichincha the republican army numbered about two thousand two hundred against some five thousand Spaniards; the royal side lost about seven hundred killed and wounded and nearly a thousand captured or scattered, and the republicans about two hundred dead. On 6 August 1824 at Junín Bolívar had around two thousand men and Canterac between three thousand five hundred and four thousand; the royalists lost about a thousand, the republicans about two hundred and fifty. On 9 December 1824 at Ayacucho Sucre had between two thousand three hundred and three thousand men against a Spanish force of thirteen to sixteen thousand once the broken remnant of Junín and the reinforcements are counted; the Spaniards lost roughly two thousand to two thousand eight hundred killed and wounded and about two thousand prisoners, the republicans some two hundred to three hundred. The Bolivian Republic was proclaimed on 9 August 1825. There was also a sterling loan raised in 1822 of about one million six hundred and eighty-three thousand pounds, with the mines of Upper Peru named as the security.
cause: 戰爭的根子有多層。最直接的一層是十八世紀末的財政與行政收緊：1776 年里奧德拉普拉塔總督區成立後，克里奧爾地方精英被排除在總督、法官與主要官職之外，內地管治與關稅制度一路收緊，礦山開採與白銀外運受到總督府與母國商人的雙重壟斷。銀礦衰減是第二層：十八世紀末起白銀產量與價格雙雙下滑，波托西、奧魯羅的礦工大批失業，稅賦卻照舊徵收，「礦役」（mita）與勞役制度把人強行拉上高山。第三層是原住民的記憶：1780 至 1781 年圖帕克·阿馬魯二世的巨大起義雖然被血腥鎮壓，1792 年圖帕克·卡塔里在艾馬拉人聚居的拉巴斯、奧魯羅一帶再度起事失敗，都留下未散的怨恨。第四層是母國的削弱：1808 年西班牙被拿破崙戰爭拖入，半島政局崩潰，1810 年 5 月布宜諾斯艾利斯革命、1812 年加的斯《自由憲章》的消息傳到安第斯，克里奧爾與混血知識分子立刻把「效忠國王」改寫成「主權屬於人民」。蘇克雷斯 1809 年 5 月在楚克薩卡宣布權力屬於「楚克薩卡主權人民」，就是這條路線的第一聲。
causeEn: The war had several layers of cause. The most immediate was the fiscal and administrative tightening of the late eighteenth century: after the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata was founded in 1776, Creole elites were kept out of the viceregal courts and the chief offices, while the new intendant system and the tariff regime closed in, and the mining of silver and its export were monopolised both by the viceregal government and by metropolitan merchants. The decline of the silver mines formed the second layer: from the late eighteenth century both output and price fell, thousands of miners in Potosí and Oruro lost their work while the taxes were levied unchanged, and the mita draft and the labour services hauled men up into the high mountains. A third layer was the memory of the indigenous: the great rising of Túpac Amaru II in 1780 and 1781 was drowned in blood, and the failed revolt of Túpac Katari in 1792 among the Aymara of La Paz and Oruro left its anger unsettled. A fourth layer was the weakening of the mother country: dragged into the Napoleonic wars in 1808, Spain fell apart politically, and the news of the May Revolution in Buenos Aires in 1810 and of the Cádiz Constitution of 1812 reached the Andes, where Creole and mestizo intellectuals immediately rewrote the formula of allegiance to the king into the claim that sovereignty resides in the people. Sucre's proclamation at Chuquisaca in May 1809 that power belonged to 'the sovereign people of Chuquisaca' was the first voice on that road.
impact: 最直接的後果是西班牙在南美洲的殖民體系散架。玻利維亞於 1825 年 8 月 9 日宣告建國，蘇克雷斯出任首任總統，蘇克雷斯城以「楚克薩卡」之名成為首都，1826 年的制憲會議把這套共和秩序寫成憲法。往後的問題卻一件接一件：上秘魯與秘魯、智利、阿根廷之間的邊界從未劃清，1838 至 1839 年爆發聯邦主義戰爭，1879 至 1884 年的太平洋戰爭讓玻利維亞丟失全部海岸，從此被叫作「沒有海的國家」，直到今日仍未解決。財政上，1822 年那筆以英鎊計的借款與英國關係糾纏至今，成為歷屆政府的沉重包袱。軍事上，這場戰爭留下了安第斯山區的游擊傳統：一八二五年隨蘇克雷斯翻越安第斯山的少年胡安·帕布羅·蒙塔涅羅斯，日後在高地上打了數十年游擊，被視為玻利維亞游擊戰的源頭；而蘇克雷斯在阿亞庫喬戰場的方陣與近距離齊射，也被後來的軍史反覆引用。十九世紀後期玻利維亞在安第斯山脈與查卡馬卡一帶的邊境戰爭，以及二十世紀後半葉高地的游擊衝突，追根溯源都能接到 1809 年這條線上。
impactEn: The most direct consequence was the coming apart of the Spanish colonial system in South America. Bolivia was proclaimed on 9 August 1825, Sucre became its first president, and the city of Sucre kept the name Chuquisaca as the capital, with the constituent assembly of 1826 writing this republican order into a constitution. But the difficulties came one after another: the borders of Upper Peru with Peru, Chile and Argentina were never drawn, the Federalist War of 1838 and 1839 followed, and the War of the Pacific of 1879 to 1884 took the entire coast from Bolivia, leaving its name trailed by the words 'without a sea', a question still unsettled today. Financially, the sterling loan of 1822 and the relations with Britain it created have remained a heavy burden for every government. Militarily, the war left behind the tradition of Andean guerrilla warfare: the boy Juan Pablo Montañero, who crossed the Andes with Sucre in 1825, spent decades fighting a guerrilla war in the highlands and is counted as the fountainhead of the Bolivian guerrilla tradition, while the formation and the massed close-range volleys of Sucre at Ayacucho were cited again and again in later military histories. The late nineteenth-century border wars of Bolivia in the Andes and around Chacamata, and the guerrilla conflicts of the highlands in the second half of the twentieth century, both trace their line back to 1809.
result: 西班牙在上秘魯的統治最終崩潰：一八二四年十二月二十四日阿亞庫喬的戰敗與總督被俘，使西班牙在南美洲最後一支野戰主力瓦解；一八二五年八月九日，玻利維亞共和國在蘇克雷斯宣告成立，蘇克雷斯任第一任總統，首都設在楚克薩卡。蘇克雷斯沒有就此罷手：一八二五年他率軍翻越安第斯山回到上秘魯，於同年十一月的英加維戰役中打垮仍效忠西班牙的殘軍與高地民兵，保住了新國家的核心地盤，取得一場實質上決定新國家邊界的勝利。戰爭結果是西班牙失去整個上秘魯，玻利維亞獲得獨立；但取勝方元氣大傷——遠征消耗、財政空虛、礦區停產，國家一開國就背著英國借款、國界未定的兩大難題，軍政領導層隨即分裂：一八二六年五月蘇克雷斯在布宜諾斯艾利斯遇刺身亡，玻利維亞進入建國初期的混亂，拉巴斯與蘇克雷斯兩派爭鬥不休，最終在一八三八年聯邦主義戰爭中分裂為玻利維亞與玻利維亞聯邦兩國。
resultEn: Spanish rule in Upper Peru collapsed: the defeat at Ayacucho on 24 December 1824 and the capture of the viceroy destroyed the last Spanish field army in South America, and on 9 August 1825 the Bolivian Republic was proclaimed at Sucre, with Sucre as its first president and the capital at Chuquisaca. He did not stop there: in 1825 he led his troops back over the Andes into Upper Peru, and in the Battle of Ingavi in November of that year he broke the remnant forces and highland militias still loyal to Spain, securing the new state's core territory in a battle that effectively settled its reach. The result of the war was that Spain lost the whole of Upper Peru and Bolivia won its independence; but the victor was exhausted, worn out by the campaigns, its finances empty and its mines idle, and the new state began its life already carrying the British loan and the undefined frontier. The military and political leadership split at once: Sucre was assassinated in Buenos Aires in May 1826, Bolivia passed through the disorder of its founding years, the La Paz and Sucre factions fought without end, and in 1838 the Federalist War divided the country into Bolivia and the Confederation of Bolivia.
